CLAUSES.title: Economic claims and commercial commitments gated on evidence
CLAUSES.statement: No licence price list, customer cost-saving claim or segment commitment SHALL be approved until (a) a shadow replay of at least 12 months of a real sponsor's grant and contribution history and (b) a 90-day time study have measured exception incidence, handling minutes, determination-reuse share, complex-gift handling hours and contact rates. Economic comparisons SHALL use the same exception definition and source for every approach, state each lever separately with its evidence and activation gate, headline Monte Carlo P50 with the P10–P90 range, and use the no-lever Unbound case (C0) as base until levers are measured. The licence used in any comparison SHALL be computed at the platform scale reachable by named target sponsors within five years, never above the addressable market. Unbound SHALL maintain a vendor P&L (revenue ramp by segment, sales and implementation per sponsor, build and maintenance capex, compliance staff, assurance fees) and a configuration SHALL be called viable only if contribution margin is positive at P90 cost and adverse licence scale. Per-tenant costs SHALL be charged on each sponsor's actual fund count. Customer-facing claims SHALL attribute savings by lever (policy delegation, determination reuse, outsourcing, software).
acceptance_criteria: Given a price list submitted before the shadow replay and time study are recorded, when approval is requested, then it is refused.
Given a model run, when rendered, then every per-approach override appears in the run log with its evidence label and C0 is reported beside C.
Given a licence scale above the addressable traditional DAF market, when used in a comparison, then the run is labelled market-exceeding and excluded from headlines.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Empirical: shadow replay and 90-day time study at a real sponsor.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Empirical: shadow replay and 90-day time study at a real sponsor.

CLAUSES.title: Market entry segment and segment activation
CLAUSES.statement: The initial target segment SHALL be mid-size national and single-issue sponsors (about 5,000–50,000 funds) and advisor-distributed sponsors, subject to CNV-ECO-003. Community foundations SHALL NOT be the entry segment: at observed sizes (median 46, p75 128, p90 313 DAFs among 802 US community foundations, DAFRC FY2024) redesign adds nothing over licensed traditional software and their systems must cover non-DAF fund types (designated, field-of-interest, scholarship, agency, endowment spending) that are out of scope; serving them requires either a partnership with community-foundation software or a separately scoped requirement set. High-volume workplace giving and outsourced-administrator models SHALL remain architecturally supported but not offered until an executed employer or administrator funding commitment covers C cost at adverse licence scale. The advisor-distributed segment SHALL be offered on sponsor admin fees only; any advisor-sponsored structure requires a sponsor-engaged-manager program defined under CNV-GRT-009. A target sponsor list with incumbents and switching triggers SHALL be maintained; no sponsor SHALL exceed 25% of annual recurring revenue after year 3 without a board-approved concentration exception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a community foundation prospect, when a sales commitment is proposed, then it requires a recorded partnership or scoped non-DAF requirement set.
Given an E4 activation request without an executed employer funding commitment, when submitted, then it is refused.

CLAUSES.title: Pre-delegation operation, stress scenarios and integration register
CLAUSES.statement: Sponsor economics SHALL be computed for a pre-delegation phase (no deterministic approval, three-distinct-person release, manual NAV checks) of parameterised duration before steady state, and onboarding plans SHALL schedule every activation gate (board delegations, auditor planned approach, ODFI and rail agreements, controller policies). The model SHALL include stress scenarios for final §4966 regulations as proposed, a 15% contribution decline, loss of the largest sponsor, licence renewal price pressure of 20% in downturn years, revenue concentration loss (top 5% of accounts) and December surge staffing costed to meet each sponsor's approved SLA floor. Each external dependency SHALL be in an integration register with counterparty, contract status, cost bearer, lead time and fallback; a sponsor activation plan SHALL NOT be marked ready while a mandatory dependency lacks an executed contract or fallback. A fixed control-time parameter per sponsor (board, controller, compliance, segregation of duties, roster coverage) SHALL be derived from a role-by-role inventory and reported separately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sponsor with no recorded board delegation, when its year-1 cost is reported, then the pre-delegation figure is shown.
Given an ODFI agreement in negotiation, when activation readiness is assessed, then readiness is false.

CLAUSES.title: Board oversight of delegated automation and ratification status
CLAUSES.statement: Where a board has delegated approval to a deterministic policy, the platform SHALL produce a quarterly board report of auto-approved, held, declined and human-reviewed grants with sampled human reviews, evidencing that the sponsor exercises variance power and exclusive legal control, and SHALL refuse to renew a delegation whose last report was not acknowledged by the board or committee. Clauses whose resolving questions are agent-recommended SHALL be shown as unratified in the baseline index and SHALL NOT be cited in customer-facing material until the owner ratifies them. A sponsor that does not adopt a mandatory policy-pack change within its deadline SHALL have the affected feature fail safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delegation whose quarterly report is unacknowledged, when renewal is requested, then it is refused.
Given an unratified clause, when marketing copy cites it, then the content check fails.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor board acknowledgment of quarterly delegation reports.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor board acknowledgment of quarterly delegation reports.

CLAUSES.title: Commercial licence and dependency rights
CLAUSES.statement: No release-1 production dependency SHALL be under a non-commercial licence without an executed commercial licence plus escrow or a fork right; a software bill of materials licence check SHALL fail on PolyForm Noncommercial components lacking such a licence. Dependency versions SHALL be pinned to tagged releases with digests through Conditor.
acceptance_criteria: Given an SBOM containing a PolyForm Noncommercial component with no licence record, when the release check runs, then it fails.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Executed commercial licence for Echelon components.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Executed commercial licence for Echelon components.

CLAUSES.title: Switching support for donors and charities
CLAUSES.statement: Sponsor migration SHALL import each donor's full fund history (contributions, grants, acknowledgments, documents) from the predecessor platform with a reconciliation report, so switching sponsors' systems does not degrade the donor record. Charities already enrolled with a supported networked grant-payment partner SHALL be paid through that enrolment without a new Unbound enrolment. Lawful distribution-partner incentives (fixed-fee platform partnerships; referral payments only where registered and permitted) SHALL be defined before partner channels launch.
acceptance_criteria: Given a migrated fund, when the import completes, then contribution and grant totals reconcile to the predecessor's statements with no unexplained difference.
Given a grantee enrolled with a supported rail partner, when a grant is released, then no additional enrolment is requested.

CLAUSES.title: Business evidence tasks
CLAUSES.statement: The evidence backlog SHALL include: at least three incumbent software price points (from Form 990 contractor disclosures, RFPs or sponsor interviews) to re-run the licensed-traditional comparator; sponsor sales-cycle length and implementation cost from at least three recent platform migrations; partner willingness-to-distribute from at least three wealth platforms; employer willingness to pay; the share of target-sponsor grantees already enrolled with networked rails; and a 50-state survey of platform, fundraising counsel and commercial co-venturer registration applicable to a white-label DAF platform built from statute and regulator sources.
acceptance_criteria: Given the evidence backlog, when the readiness report is generated, then each item shows owner, due date and status.
